prediction_timestamp: first assignment time after the approved single-item plan is known
cold_start: overall, issue and catalog counts are zero where absent; corresponding averages and efficiencies remain missing
catalog_service_semantics: canonical service/catalog display-name label, preserving Unicode, case, internal whitespace and punctuation; surrounding whitespace only is trimmed
internal_catalog_identity: service_catalog_items.id is retained outside the model feature vector and exclusively keys exact-catalog historical aggregates

warranty_mapping.technical_action: normalize repair_items.warranty_remedy, service_catalog_items.warranty_remedy, or actual technical catalog to REPAIR|REPLACEMENT
warranty_mapping.legacy_service_type: service_types.code WARRANTY remains for compatibility and is not an ML technical action

service_interruption_limitation: persisted service interruptions are not yet subtracted by production duration services

base_job.business_meaning: Known device, issue, approved action, catalog standard, branch and calendar context.
base_job.availability: Available when the first assignment begins after the single-item plan is known.
base_job.leakage_safety: No completion, feedback, future status or generated latent factor.

technician_overall.availability: Computed only from jobs completed before prediction.
technician_overall.leakage_safety: Strict completed_at < prediction_timestamp; unfinished concurrent jobs are excluded.

technician_issue.business_meaning: Prior experience of the technician on the same issue.
technician_issue.availability: Derived from earlier completed matching jobs.
technician_issue.leakage_safety: Strict as-of boundary; zero count and missing statistics mean cold start.

technician_catalog.business_meaning: Prior experience on the exact catalog service.
technician_catalog.availability: Derived from earlier completed matching jobs.
technician_catalog.leakage_safety: Strict as-of boundary; no full-data aggregation or target fill.

ablation_policy: fixed conservative XGB parameters, same TimeSeriesSplit folds, development rows only; holdout untouched
final_feature_decision: All 20 predeclared candidate features retained after business availability, leakage, correlation and cumulative ablation review; no automatic correlation threshold was used.
